result_text:
The region overview now lists open tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, oldest first within each priority. The full offline test suite passes with no failures or errors.

The change is in `listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java` (around line 10020). It now uses the same `ORDER BY` as the sales-rep list: `CASE t.priority WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 0 WHEN 'NORMAL' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, t.opened_date, t.id`. I also updated its doc comment to match. The WHERE clause is unchanged, so closed tickets and other regions are still excluded. Nothing is committed.
